title: Why Your AI Agent Isn't Delivering ROI | Live in London
description:
Register now:
In person (London): https://tessl.co/w9x
Virtual (livestream): https://tessl.co/l6w

Tuesday 29 September 2026 · 18:00 BST · Tessl offices, King's Cross, London + livestream

Most AI agents underperform in production. The model is usually fine – the problem is that the data around the agent is incomplete and nobody is measuring the results. Join AI Native Dev at the Tessl offices in King's Cross, or on the livestream, for an evening on where AI ROI really comes from.

On the agenda:
– The ROI Isn't in the Agent – Rob Willoughby, Member of Technical Staff, AI Research at Tessl. Rob works on evaluation research for coding agents: how to design assessments and understand model performance at scale.
– Data Blindspots: The Hidden Killer of AI ROI – Tom Scott, CEO of Streambased. Tom has 20+ years in distributed systems and data infrastructure, with a focus on event streaming and big data.

Schedule (UK time):
18:00 – Doors open
18:30 – The ROI Isn't in the Agent
19:00 – Data Blindspots: The Hidden Killer of AI ROI
19:30 – Networking
20:30 – Close

Can't make it to London? Both talks will be streamed live, so register for the virtual option and watch from anywhere.
